page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the left margin (several small notes at the upper left, one reference "Cap.3.16." beside a line lower left). Running head at top right; page number top left.

main_text.p: mei, scientes, quoniam maius iudicium sit mitis. Et vere non aliunde tot haereses & schismata proseminantur, quàm quòd, quilibet ad suum iudicium, scripturas interpretetur, atque ad noua sua commenta accommodare conetur, vt veteres dixerunt, * Lib 2. de Trinit. & li. 2. ad Constant.* Hilarius, † In cap. 1. ad Gal. & contra Lucifer.† Hieronymus, ‡ lib. 12. confess. cap. 25.‡ Augustinus, * In 7. Synod. Act. 6.* Epiphanius.
main_text.head: GOMARVS.
main_text.p: RECTE de Haereticorum temeritate queritur Hieronymus, sed male illius verba accommodas. Non enim quamlibet, sed accuratiorem scientiam intelligit: quam, vt ait, in multis doctoribus ecclesiae, aut raro, aut difficulter inuenias. Nam quàm multis mulierculis nominatim scripturae cognitionem attribuit? Similiter ad Paulinum scribens, moderatam & Sacris literis consentientem interpretandi rationem vulgo non detrahit, sed temeritatem & praeposterum interpretationis modum reprehendit. Nam quemadmodum Paulus Apostolus ad Colossenses ait, Verbum Christi habitet in vobis abundanter, in omni sapientia, docentes & Cap.3.16.

page.notes: Right-margin side and faint marginal fragments at left are largely illegible; the note beside "Colossenses" is a bare reference. Heading "GOMARVS" treated as level 2 section title. Final word of page "commu-" is printed as "comm-" and taken as catchword-like line end.
